## Outcome and binding

Planning review of one concrete physical-kernel ownership and numeric-contract proposal for the continuing creative-character loop:

**Encounter → physical field/graph change → independent mood and attention → physical associative recall → choice → observed outcome → memory.**

Personal head **6a4438982fdf1eca98f856748bb23b19ab017c0a**, branch `codex/cephalon-kernel-selection`, stacked on personal base **1069d4c9bcba29ef55e6c72c7c597de101f0520b**, branch `codex/cephalon-personal-review` (parent #22). Both head and base repositories are `riatzukiza/foresight`. Parent #22 and its sync parent #3 retain independent qualification; parent review/approval is historical input here, never approval of this child. Ready for review; auto-merge remains off.

## Concrete decision

- Propose existing standalone `octave-commons/eros-eris-field` as the physical computation owner, portable `.cljc` law/shape/domain plus one compiled CLJS Node authority; TS exports delegate. No second force engine in Knoxx/Foresight.
- Keep OpenPlanner trusted storage/query and Knoxx independent mood/attention/traits/social choice at their proper boundaries. Keep existing canonical identity/event/grant/lifecycle authorities separate.
- Specify finite binary64, world-unit dimensions, integer-microsecond time, exact zero no-op, 10ms quantum/residual/backlog, bounded 100-substep catch-up, elapsed-time damping/decay, eight sparse velocity-amplitude field layers, one typed intent-bond topology, strict friction order, immutable emitted ownership, conserved integer intent exchange and seeded noise/replay.
- Make traced physical contacts and paths influence authorized recall. Scope precedes all causal influence; polling cannot re-emit or reinforce. Semantic feedback requires an actual idempotent choice/outcome and truthful persistence failure.
- Preserve separate explicit blockers: owning source plan/ABI, further source qualification, source/distribution licensing, physical calibration/load caps, uncertain partial-exchange policy, native Rheos relationship admission and later source/deployment qualification.
